name: coordination/refusal-unknown-task
description: `task_status` for anything this surface did not dispatch. The same `404` for a made-up id, a malformed one, and — the point — an inbound proposal sitting in the operator's own task inbox. `task_status` is not `task_show`: it reads the dispatch ledger only, so it can never become a way for a coordination driver to discover that inbound work exists.

problem.title: no task dispatched from this surface has that reference

expected.body: {"type":"urn:akson:error:unknown-task","title":"no task dispatched from this surface has that reference","status":404}
